final_message: I parsed the log file by reading it line by line and identifying log entries using a regex for the first line format. I filtered entries with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC ISO format, extracted the service, message, and the last line of any traceback as the exception. I also summed the repeat counts from the following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I aggregated the counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the required structure and format.
